summary_en: This Phase 1 trial tests neratinib together with fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki (TDxD) in advanced or unresectable gastric and esophageal cancer that overexpresses HER2, and in other gastrointestinal cancers with HER2 IHC 3+. Neratinib is taken as a daily pill on days 1 through 21 at doses of 120 mg, 160 mg, or 200 mg, and TDxD is given intravenously on day 1 of each 21-day cycle at a standard dose of 5.4 mg/m2. The study measures safety, toxicity, the recommended phase 2 dose, and the maximum tolerated dose.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba neratinib junto con fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki (TDxD) en cáncer gástrico y esofágico avanzado o no resecable que sobreexpresa HER2, y en otros cánceres gastrointestinales con HER2 IHC 3+. El neratinib se toma como pastilla diaria los días 1 al 21, en dosis de 120 mg, 160 mg o 200 mg, y el TDxD se administra por vía intravenosa el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días, a una dosis estándar de 5.4 mg/m2. El estudio mide la seguridad, la toxicidad, la dosis recomendada para fase 2 y la dosis máxima tolerada.
who_for: Unresectable or metastatic gastrointestinal cancer, such as esophagus, stomach, colon, biliary, pancreas, or unknown primary likely GI.
HER2 overexpression: IHC 3+ or IHC2+/ISH+ for gastroesophageal cancer; IHC 3+ for other GI cancers.
Progressed or intolerant after at least one prior HER2-directed therapy for metastatic disease (gastroesophageal cancers).
Measurable or evaluable disease by RECIST 1.1.
ECOG performance status 0-2 with blood counts and organ function within the stated limits.
not_for: Chemotherapy or radiotherapy within 2 weeks before the first dose, or prior treatment with TDxD.
Interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, or lung disease needing oxygen support.
Use of strong inhibitors or inducers of neratinib or TDxD.
